in_marathi.name: Parminder
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parminder हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parminder is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name where 'Parm' means supreme or universal and 'inder' means lord or master. Hence, Parminder translates to 'Lord of the World'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is regarded as the supreme god and ruler of the universe.
